question: Which state government launched the novel ‘Chief Minister’s Breakfast Scheme’ in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the scheme, **breakfast **will be provided to primary school children from 1st to 5th standard studying in Government schools on all school working days 
 
• The scheme was launched by **CM M K Stalin**.
 
• The significant breakfast scheme has been rolled out after **102 years**, when P. Theagaraya Chetty, the then President of the Corporation (Mayor) of the Justice Party approved the proposal to provide tiffin to students of a Corporation School at Thousand Lights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55d68abbba7e19322a01cdfda63450440d55bc44aaf2c5740061506aae8b0c24.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh** 

 
 
• YSR Yantra Seva Scheme
 
• Under this project, CM YS Jagan Mohan Reddy has distributed tractors and combined harvesters.
 
 
 
• **Kerala **
 
 
• ‘Vanikaran’ project
 
• This scheme was launched to restore natural vegetation.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**
 
 
• Single-Use Plastic Buy-Back Scheme
 
• Under the Single-Use Plastic Buy Back Scheme, The Himachal Pradesh government would purchase single-use plastic items from students of schools and colleges
